name: T5_property_transport

provenance.source: Card Model Research Handover (2026-10-22), sections 8, 11 and the theorems the formal core needs

statement: Upward-closed properties transport to multiples and downward-closed ones to divisors; containing a factor is upward closed, staying inside a fragment downward closed; gcd keeps downward-closed properties and lcm upward-closed ones.
